name: URDF
summary: XML format for describing a robot model: links, joints, inertial, visual and collision properties. It is the de facto robot description exchanged between ROS tools and many simulators.

knowledge.rationale: URDF describes the kinematic and physical structure of a robot.

version.label: Specification maintained by the ROS community (no version number published)

license.name: Parser libraries BSD-3-Clause; licence of the specification text not stated

licenses.name: BSD 3-Clause (ROS 2 URDF parsing packages)
licenses.reviewNote: As granted by the licence text; dependencies and third-party components not assessed. Not legal advice.

limitations.text: The specification pages on the ROS wiki block automated checks; identity is confirmed through the reference parser repositories.

engineeringUses: Exchanging a robot’s kinematic structure between design tools, ROS and simulators
Describing links, joints and collision geometry for motion planning

sources.title: urdfdom — URDF parser (robot model: links, joints, materials)
